blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Government information and technology officials have appealed to critics to understand that protecting people’s lives takes precedence over the continuous availability of social networking sites. The plea comes as the ban on the messaging apps Reddit and Discord is lifted. Information and Communications Technology Secretary Henry Aguda and Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) chief Undersecretary Renato Paraiso explained that they had to order the ban. The two officials cited the need to ensure that the business persons behind the online applications would comply with directives to protect the Filipino children.
